items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: There was Billy Murray at bass, Jimmy Fallon's violin, and they had this Mick Murray on the drum.

ctx.x: Well, did you know any of the guys in these different bands? Did you know people in Perez's and the Golden Rule and Bowling?

You know any of the other men? Yeah, I don't know any of the other bands. Yeah, I don't know any of the other bands. It was Maine Perez, Alphonse Pico. There was Billy Murray at bass, Jimmy Fallon's violin, and they had this Mick Murray on the drum. Tramborne was, let me try to get this number just to make it straight, Phil. The name was Phil. And that's my first wife, my first wife's cousin, Phil.
Was he related to George Phil? I don't know.
